scope: Modbus TCP MBAP plus FC01/02/03/04 reads, FC05/06 single writes, FC0F/10 multiple writes; all normal response layouts and generic exception layout; FC0F arbitrary 1..1968 coils including final-byte padding. Complete static profile; no runtime encoder.
example_validation: protocol envelope and length consistency; scoped BACnet decoder checks for runtime fixtures; not live service conformance

execution_contract.dependencies: whitelisted operations only; scope and when are annotations
execution_contract.content_scalar_strategies: runtime uses AFL field projection; values/strategies are annotations for CONTENT scalars
execution_contract.runtime_encode: capability assertion derived from runtime support and message direction; never an execution switch
